name: EAC Invest A/S
summary: EAC Invest A/S operates as an investment company. It produces acrylics in Thailand; and bottled water to hotels, embassies, and consulates in China. The company was formerly known as Santa Fe Group A/S and changed its name to EAC Invest A/S in November 2019. EAC Invest A/S was founded in 1897 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
